newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks sink in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks sink in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks sank in early Friday morning trade as market participants found it difficult to take up fresh positions ahead of the weekend and before the start of the new calendar month, brokers said.
By 0024 GMT, the Nikkei 225 had fallen 190.46 points, or 1.00 percent, to 18,831.10. Its March futures were down 160 points at 18,830.

"Window-dressing could occur as it is the last day of February," a broker at a medium-size brokerage said. "But blue-chip rises may be stymied by the stronger yen and lower-priced, large capital issues will be bought instead."
